name: cadbury
description: A floating voice pet for Claude Code and opencode: talk to your coding agent, hear what it did.

scripts.check: bun build bridge/index.ts --target=bun --outdir=/tmp/cadbury-check >/dev/null && node --check desktop/main.js && node --check web/app.js && node --check web/voice.js && node --check web/voice-gemini.js && node --check web/sprite.js && echo ok
